notes: 👈 Swipe left on a food to delete it, like any iPhone list. Swipe a little to show Delete, or all the way to delete straight away.
🗑️ In Add food → Your foods, deleting removes it from your list and usuals. Your past logs stay, and it comes back if you ever log it again.
🍽️ Swipe left on anything in the day's food to remove it, or hold a usual and pick Delete from your foods.
